title: Music player READ DESCRIPTION
features:
This is a music player. Most music player guis use Roblox sound ids. But this gui uses mp3 files so you can play any song. Also. ⚠️THIS IS FULLY CLIENT SIDED WHICH MEANS ONLY YOU WILL HEAR THE AUDIO PLAYING⚠️


Here’s a tutorial. I use mobile so it may be different on pc

Step one: execute the script

Step two: go into files then goto your executor then workspace where you’ll find a folder named MyMusic. If you don’t see the folder please tell me in the scriptblox comments

Step three: download any song you want. You can do this by going onto google and searching the song name you want and then put mp3 at the end. For example. (Songname mp3 file)


Step four: go back into Roblox and execute the script again after adding the song mp3s in the folder


Step five: enjoy your music


If there’s any problems and want them fixed please tell me. Thanks for using the script
